items.title: Lens: Rethinking Training Efficiency for Foundational Text-to-Image Models
items.anchor: ## Batch、tokens 与 optimizer steps 不是同一计量
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: Foundational text-to-image training can spend many updates on low-information supervision, while a smaller model alone does not explain convergence efficiency.
items.adopted_proposition: 训练效率不能只用单步 FLOPs 表示；应同时记录每步计算、batch 中可用信息密度与达到目标质量所需步数。稠密 caption、混合分辨率/宽高比与表示选择可以共同改变 quality-per-update，但 19.3% 计算量只属于论文披露的模型、数据与比较基线，不能外推为通用配方。

items.anchor: ### Dropout Schedule 也是 Training State
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: Constant dropout applies the same perturbation even though early representation formation and late convergence face different noise budgets.
items.adopted_proposition: Treat dropout schedule as training state: front-loading can regularize early signal propagation while reducing late optimization noise, but mean-field edge-of-chaos assumptions and tested architectures bound the claim.

items.title: Models Can Model, But Can't Bind: Structured Grounding in Text-to-Optimization
items.anchor: ### Abstract Intent 需要有界解析为 Primitive Tool
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: 旧路径让同一语言模型同时提出优化结构并填入数字、实体与索引；当结构推理正确而 binding 仍错时，把变量/约束 schema 与外部结构化数据分离，由确定性 binder 生成 solver input，模型只拥有结构 proposal，binder/checker 拥有标识解析，solver 拥有数值可行性。

items.title: PromptNCE: Pointwise Mutual Information Predictions Using Only LLMs and Contrastive Estimation Prompts
items.anchor: #### Raw Score 只有经过标签校准才是概率
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: A prompted finite-choice distribution can rank offered answers while silently assigning zero observable mass to unlisted alternatives, so its probabilities are not automatically calibrated confidence.
items.adopted_proposition: 有限候选 prompt 得到的概率会在已列选项内重新归一化，不能直接当作绝对置信度；显式 `OTHER` 可在论文假设下承接遗漏质量，但仍必须用真实标签校准，且不能把理论恢复条件外推成模型知道全部答案空间。

items.evaluation_locator: §4 Benchmark; §5 Results; Appendix A.4 Recalibration; Appendix A.5 Stability

items.evidence_boundary: The theory and three disclosed datasets support a conditional-probability estimator under stated assumptions, not universal calibration, factuality, or confidence outside the offered outcome construction.

items.title: LiveR: Fine-Grained Elasticity via Live Reconfiguration for Model Training
items.anchor: ### Live Reconfiguration 需要 Target World 与显式 Commit
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: To reduce user costs and maximize cluster utilization, large model training increasingly leverages volatile but inexpensive GPU capacity, such as spot instances and reclaimable resources in shared clusters.
items.adopted_proposition: 弹性训练不能把 topology change 只实现为 storage-backed restart；可并行准备 target world、以有界额外内存迁移混合并行状态，但 source world 在显式验证与原子 commit 前仍拥有训练进度，失败时必须回退 checkpoint/restart。
items.evidence_boundary: Only exact-v1 disclosed workloads and conditions are supported; model/hardware/precision/length/batch/concurrency/SLO/evaluator not disclosed are Not Disclosed.
items.tradeoff: A dual-world handoff consumes bounded extra memory, initialization capacity and network bandwidth while the live world trains, and concurrent preparation can interfere with the critical path.
items.failure_fallback: If target-world preparation misses the warning window, transfer validation fails or the commit cannot be atomic, abort the handoff and use the existing checkpoint/restart recovery path.
items.state_control_ownership: source world 在 commit 前拥有训练进度；target world 只拥有候选执行状态；controller 在目标布局、版本与状态完整性验证后拥有切换 commit；失败时 checkpoint/restart 仍是恢复路径。

items.title: The Value of Covariance Matching in Gaussian DDPMs and the Lanczos Sampler
items.anchor: ### 加速后的输出必须与未加速轨迹建立一致性边界

items.title: Representation Gap: Explaining the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Neural Networks from a Geometric Perspective
items.anchor: ## Inductive bias：为什么有限数据仍可能产生泛化
items.old_baseline_and_constraint_change: Ch5 already explains that architecture, optimization and augmentation impose inductive bias and that deployment evaluation must challenge shortcuts. The missing delta is an assumption-bounded geometric diagnostic connecting symmetry, task intrinsic dimension and sample scaling across supervised and generative tasks.
items.adopted_proposition: 泛化不能只由参数量或训练误差解释；在论文限定的渐近几何设置中，数据流形与训练后模型预测空间之间的 representation gap 由任务 intrinsic dimension 支配，equivariance 通过虚拟扩增训练样本、降低有效维度来改变样本效率。该指标不是任意现实模型的通用 generalization error。
items.method_locator: arXiv:2605.21692v1 HTML §4.1–§4.5 theoretical results, including virtual augmentation, non-conditional diffusion, supervised prediction and comparison with generalization error
items.evaluation_locator: §5.1 theorem validation on synthetic manifolds and supervised tasks; §5.2 intrinsic-dimension estimation on synthetic and real datasets
items.nonproof_locator: Appendix G Limitations; asymptotic regime, regular compact manifold/group-action and fully optimized model assumptions; DDIM/linear-Gaussian focus for the generative derivation
items.evidence_boundary: The source supports an assumption-bounded geometric diagnostic. It does not identify arbitrary modern networks' generalization error, prove exact symmetry in deployed data, or replace held-out and distribution-shift evaluation.
items.tradeoff: The metric makes symmetry/sample geometry explicit but requires multiple sample sizes/model fits and strong asymptotic, manifold, optimization and equivariance assumptions.
items.failure_fallback: When those assumptions or estimates cannot be validated, retain the current inductive-bias explanation and decide by held-out, counterfactual and distribution-shift evaluation.
items.state_control_ownership: The estimator owns only a geometric diagnostic; architecture/data owners define symmetry and sampling, while Evaluation retains acceptance authority and may reject the estimate when its assumptions or held-out behavior fail.

root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.title: Value-Gradient Hypothesis of RL for LLMs
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.anchor: ## Sequence reward 与 token updates 的错位
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.proposed_delta: 旧解释把 critic-free GRPO 视为把 sequence scalar 复制到 token，简单但容易误读为没有 value-like temporal signal。一个受限解释把 actor backward 的 hidden-state sensitivity 视作 empirical costate：连续可微、additive-noise rollout 下其条件期望等于 value gradient；离散 transformer 只沿 attention path 传播，token sampling path 缺失且误差受 entropy/sampling gap 约束。Reward/verifier 仍拥有 outcome，autodiff 只产生 credit proposal，optimizer 提交 update，evaluation 用 matched trajectory 和 reachable headroom 决定是否采用。代价是 hidden-gradient/rollout 诊断、假设敏感与探索—低熵张力；假设不成立时回退标准 score-function/advantage、process reward、显式 critic 或 held-out checkpoint sweep，不能把该理论当成普适因果证明。
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.evidence_boundary: The evidence supplies an assumption-bounded interpretation and diagnostic, not proof that practical GRPO differentiates through sampled tokens, that attention costates equal a learned critic, or that low entropy guarantees correct long-horizon credit in arbitrary LLMs.
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.tradeoff: Costate/headroom diagnostics can expose when critic-free updates have usable credit, but require hidden-state gradients, matched rollouts and reward estimates; low entropy may reduce the modeled sampling gap while also reducing exploration.
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.failure_fallback: If the differentiability, entropy-bound or matched-trajectory assumptions fail, treat the update as an ordinary score-function estimator, retain explicit advantage/verifier diagnostics, add process reward or a learned critic where justified, and select checkpoints by held-out RL outcomes rather than the predictor.

root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.title: X-Token: Projection-Guided Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Distillation
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.anchor: ### 跨 Tokenizer 蒸馏需要共享概率接口，而不只是共享文本

root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.evidence_boundary: The evidence supports coverage-aware projection choices in disclosed tokenizer pairs; string/re-tokenization mappings are approximations and do not prove semantic token equivalence, complete mass conservation or multilingual/byte-boundary fidelity.

root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.failure_fallback: If canonicalization, critical-class coverage, residual mass or behavioral regression fails, retain same-tokenizer KD, byte-level alignment with explicit residuals, or hard sequence distillation and do not merge incompatible token probabilities.

root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.evidence_boundary: The adopted claim is an inspectable compression-objective certificate plus separate behavioral gates. Being within 1% of the LP lower bound does not prove a tokenizer is optimal for language modeling, multilingual fairness, latency or an existing checkpoint.
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.tradeoff: Convex optimization reduces greedy objective regret but introduces solver/rounding cost, sample sensitivity and artifact incompatibility; better intrinsic metrics may not translate to consistent downstream gains.
root_applied_fresh_semantic_pass.failure_fallback: If the LP is too large, rounding is unstable, multilingual slices regress or downstream/lifecycle cost fails, retain BPE/Unigram and use the lower bound only to quantify unexplained compression headroom.
